# LiteRT C ABI 头文件 / LiteRT C ABI headers

这些未修改的公开头文件来自 Google LiteRT `v2.1.0rc1`，用于编译 MTK dispatch 包装库。
`provenance.json` 记录原始来源和 SHA-256；Apache-2.0 许可见 `LICENSE`。
`litert/build_common/build_config.h` 是上游 `config/build_config_gpu_npu.h` 的原样副本，
替代上游构建时生成的同名文件。包装库只使用公开 C ABI，不构建或访问 LiteRT 内部对象。

These unmodified public headers come from Google LiteRT `v2.1.0rc1` for the MTK dispatch
wrapper. `provenance.json` records sources and SHA-256 hashes; see `LICENSE` for Apache-2.0.
`litert/build_common/build_config.h` is an exact copy of upstream
`config/build_config_gpu_npu.h`, replacing the file normally generated by the upstream build.
The wrapper uses public C ABI declarations without constructing or accessing LiteRT internals.
